families.title: Use useState for local state
families.summary: Use useState for simple local component state; each framework-specific variant keeps its own guidance.
families.rationale: React and React Native share the local-state norm; framework APIs and examples stay in separate variants.

families.title: Use useReducer for complex state
families.summary: Use useReducer for complex state transitions; each framework-specific variant keeps its own guidance.
families.rationale: React and React Native share the reducer norm; framework APIs and examples stay in separate variants.
